BTC, Lightning and interface update:
- Blue BTC wallets now use SHA-256 with Native SegWit receive addresses. BTC and XBT keep their own chain connections and labels.
- New XBT installations use Kilombino's SSL Fulcrum preset with normal certificate verification.
- Wallet balance and cards stay fixed while transaction history scrolls. Verified-chain status has a green LED.
- Settings and its submenus use centered regular-weight uppercase headings, smaller labels, and adjacent sections. Donate and Support sit together.
- Added Dark Angel and Templar to the saved logo-tap skin cycle.
- Wallet refresh errors that complete after leaving the wallet screen no longer cover Receive.
- Automatic connection failures update connection status without interrupting menus or Add Wallet.
- Lightning hidden balances and sensitive-action checks are tightened. New channels retain the 10,000,000-sat opening cap, and resize progress distinguishes local confirmations from peer lock status.


- Lightning payments check the node's recorded status before offering another send. Interrupted replies are reconciled without automatic resending; already-paid and pending invoices are held.
- Known pre-submission validation or sync errors are distinguished from unresolved payment results. Check Payment Status reads history without sending money.
- PAY (INVOICE) now uses all capital letters.

Please check BTC/XBT labels, receive QR amounts, Settings menus, and the saved skins on your iPhone. SHA-256 connections use direct TLS. Tor covers the embedded Lightning paths and configured watchtowers; it does not register a watchtower, and exchange quotes still use direct HTTPS.

The pinned dashboard now clears the native toolbar and status bar.

- Confirmed Lightning payments show a green PAYMENT SUCCEEDED receipt with amount and payment reference. Already-paid invoices are identified without sending again. Receipt details and copying respect hidden balances.
- Definite failures and validation refusals have clear headings and available safe reasons. Pending, unknown, and unavailable status reads remain distinct; uncertain replies never trigger an automatic resend.

- Tap the main Wallets total to cycle XBT, sats, your price estimate and hidden stars. Hiding keeps a tappable mask so the amount can be shown again; General > Total Balance still controls the whole section. Hidden totals also hide the separate BTC subtotal and price estimate.
- Sent transaction amounts use red with a minus sign; settled incoming amounts remain green.

- Network settings now separate XBT Fulcrum from BTC SHA-256 servers. Set your own SHA-256 Electrum/Fulcrum host, port and SSL settings, with optional trusted certificate support. The SHA-256 chain is checked before saving.
- Custom BTC settings persist separately and never silently fall back to a public endpoint. Restore BTC Default explicitly returns to Blockstream. TCP is available only as an explicit unencrypted transport choice; BTC onion connections are not supported here.
